Learning Management System
The Learning Management System (LMS) developed by the Bureau of Indian Standards is a comprehensive platform for online learning that enables self-paced digital education. It is designed to support continuous knowledge enhancement and skill development across stakeholders. By facilitating accessible and structured learning, the LMS contributes to national capacity building and plays a significant role in strengthening the quality ecosystem in the country.

What people say about us
The sessions were incredibly insightful, interactive, and immensely beneficial to all the participants. The content covered during the programme was both comprehensive and relevant, providing valuable insights into various aspects of standardization and its significance in our industry. The sessions led by Mr. Rajeev Ranjan Singh, Mr. Kundan Giri, and Mr. Gaurav Jayaswal were particularly enlightening, and their expertise truly enriched our learning experience. We are sincerely thankful for BIS's willingness to conduct the training program at Tata Motors premises, which facilitated seamless participation from our officials. Looking ahead, we eagerly anticipate future opportunities for such enriching training programs and continued collaboration with BIS.
Shri Kishore Kumar Patil
